title: CRPS - Real-Time Facial Recognition System
description: A comprehensive real-time facial recognition system that combines advanced computer vision techniques and vector databases to efficiently identify and search for faces in surveillance, access control, and user authentication scenarios.
overview_p1: This project implements a cutting-edge facial recognition system that addresses the challenges of fast and accurate face identification in real-world scenarios. The system handles various factors such as different facial angles, occlusions, varying lighting conditions, and the need to match faces against a large dataset of known identities.
overview_p2: The solution combines state-of-the-art techniques: YuNet for precise face detection even in challenging conditions, FaceNet for generating robust facial embeddings invariant to pose and lighting, and Weaviate as a vector database optimized for similarity search. This architecture ensures both accuracy and efficiency in real-time operations.
overview_p3: With an intuitive PyQt graphical interface, encrypted data storage for security, and multi-threaded processing for real-time performance, the system provides a comprehensive solution suitable for surveillance systems, access control, and user authentication applications.
features: Graphical user interface built with PyQt

challenges.title: Robust Face Detection
challenges.description: Implemented YuNet detector to accurately locate faces in challenging conditions including varying angles, occlusions, and lighting.

challenges.title: Efficient Similarity Search
challenges.description: Leveraged Weaviate vector database to perform fast similarity searches across large datasets of facial embeddings.

challenges.title: Real-time Performance
challenges.description: Designed multi-threaded architecture separating camera I/O from processing to maintain real-time performance without blocking.
